script.narration: Hi everyone! Today, I’ll show you how to start a blank app on DexAppBuilder at dexappbuilder.dexkit.com. First, visit the homepage and look for the “Build My App” button. You can find it either in the center or at the top of the page. Next, simply click the button to get started with your app creation. It’s quick and easy to begin building your project without any coding. For more details, check out the blog “NFT Storefronts: Build and Launch Without Code with DexAppBuilder.”
